lessons_used: Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to actual noise-corrected results.
No kind of change has been helpful yet, as no tests have won.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout to showcase the companion certificate prominently.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion to 60.9% and takes a median duration of 89s (mean 1017s).

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your desktop companion's details to complete the adoption process.

guard.reason: Redesigning the certificate layout inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4 as long as the screen functionality remains intact.

candidates.score_note: High drop step, but redesigns have not yielded positive lift in previous tests.

candidates.title: Home Waiting Estimate & Notification
candidates.change: Display an estimated waiting timer and enable desktop notifications while the pet is initializing.
candidates.why: The waiting step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s, causing user drops during desktop pet generation.

waiting.hint: We are bringing your pet to life! You will be notified as soon as it arrives on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding an estimated wait time and ready notifications during actual pet creation is allowed under rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high mean wait duration on home step.

candidates.title: Sign-In Data Protection Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent explanatory hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in preserves pet customization across sessions.
candidates.why: Support received 8 separate emails reporting lost or reset pets after re-signing into the app.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your desktop pet securely to your account so you never lose your companion or progress.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory hint to the sign-in screen is valid copy customization within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 8 support tickets and high funnel drop; low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Controls Guide Screen
candidates.change: Insert a clear desktop controls introduction screen after completing onboarding to explain pet interaction and visibility controls.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and multiple users wrote to support confused about how to hide or talk to their pet.

new_desktop_controls_overview.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_controls_overview.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide, chat, or access settings right from your desktop toolbar.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls guide screen after home_intro inside onboarding is explicitly permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence, but adding a new screen on finish previously yielded -5.7% lift.

candidates.title: Simplified Path Selection Copy
candidates.change: Simplify headline and body copy on choose_path screen to clarify choices and reduce hesitation.
candidates.why: Path selection takes a high mean duration of 514s and loses 23.8% of users right at the beginning.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Create Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick quick setup to adopt immediately or custom photo setup to create a unique companion.

guard.reason: Clarifying copy on choose_path while maintaining options to adopt or create your own complies with rules 2 and 4.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy tweak targeting initial step hesitation.

candidates.title: Early Path Selection Reorder
candidates.change: Place the path selection step before the story introduction screen so users immediately pick their setup path on launch.
candidates.why: Accelerates initial engagement and cuts down high mean decision times (514s) at start.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Photo Guidelines Pre-Upload Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a photo guidelines sub-flow screen right before photo uploads to prevent custom generation errors.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or malformed output during photo adoption.

new_photo_guidelines.headline: Tips for Great Custom Pets
new_photo_guidelines.body: Upload clear, well-lit front photos for best pet creation results.

guard.reason: Inserting a photo guidelines screen as a sub-flow prior to upload is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Solves photo errors, but new flows in adoption step previously performed poorly (-5.0%).

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Configure desktop notification alerts when home welcome screen displays so users notice pet launch on screen.
candidates.why: Support received complaints about pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to open visually.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Look at your screen! Your new companion is now running on your desktop.

guard.reason: Configuring desktop notifications and copy on the home_intro screen is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Config-based fix addressing direct support complaints about pet visibility.

candidates.title: Path Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Show onboarding step progress counter and progress bar during path selection.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low (17.8%), and showing step progress early sets clear completion expectations.

guard.reason: Adding onboarding progress indicators to the choose_path screen is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targets overall onboarding drop, but evidence on first step is moderate.

candidates.title: Sign-In Split Screen Layout
candidates.change: Change sign-in screen to a split layout showcasing account benefits alongside sign-in options.
candidates.why: Sign in converts at 72.9% with 8 support issues tied to lost account pets.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Companion Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to back up your desktop pet and sync settings across devices.

guard.reason: Changing the sign-in layout to a split screen with benefit messaging is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence on sign-in, but requires full layout redesign.
